items.html: And it is therefore found that the hairs of the four strands that spread together with the four white ones at the back of the head of Arich Anpin are drawn into the head of ZA from behind, until the place of the nape, which is behind the third brain called Daat of ZA. And also the hairs of the beard of Arich Anpin spread along the face and join the face of ZA, and there the beard of ZA is made. And these two aspects are mentioned in Idra de Nasso: the first aspect on page 135, and the second aspect on page 129a.
